争议焦点：
• 针对手机成瘾的技术解决方案的有效性和复杂性。userbinator质疑通过设计复杂系统来解决分心问题的必要性，而其他人如tmhrtly和ricardobeat则分享了具体的工具和方法。

data.title: FreeBSD Kernel Modules Pkg(8) Repositories
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: FreeBSD项目开始在默认安装中添加内核模块pkg仓库，从14.3-RELEASE版本起实施。问题源于pkg包在非x.0版本（如x.1、x.2等）发布后的构建方式，这些包基于当前支持的最旧版本，导致与新内核的ABI不兼容，尤其影响DRM图形驱动，引发系统崩溃。为解决此问题，FreeBSD引入了独立的内核模块pkg仓库，分别为quarterly和latest分支，并在14.3-RELEASE中正式采用。这解决了新版本发布后三个月内旧版本支持期内 kernel 模块不兼容的问题。虽然可通过ZFS启动环境缓解，但新增仓库为更直接的解决方案。用户可在配置文件中启用这些新仓库以获取兼容的内核模块。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：FreeBSD操作系统及其内核模块和包管理

不同观点：
• Padriac认为FreeBSD是他最喜欢的操作系统，对任何与之相关的内容都会引起他的关注。这表明他对FreeBSD有很高的评价和个人偏好。

• ggm-at-algebras对通过包进行内核修改表现出兴趣，并希望通过这种方式实现一个更小的内核。他设想了一条从可加载模块到静态内核的路径，目标是减少内核的大小和关键依赖的规模。这显示出对FreeBSD内核优化和定制的高度关注。

• yjftsjthsd-h关注包管理系统与实际安装的次版本号的关联问题，担心包管理器会在新次版本安装之前尝试安装对应模块。他的评论反映了对软件包和版本兼容性的实际操作担忧。

补充讨论：
• ggm-at-algebras的评论还提到，他设想通过指定最小集合的kernel Makefile来实现内核优化，这表明他对技术细节和内核构建过程有深入的思考和期望。

• yjftsjthsd-h的评论隐含了对包管理系统行为的一种潜在风险的担忧，特别是版本不匹配可能导致系统不稳定的问题。

争议焦点：
• 主要争议点在于系统稳定性和功能扩展之间的平衡。ggm-at-algebras追求内核的最小化和优化，而yjftsjthsd-h则担心包管理系统在处理版本更新时可能带来的兼容性和稳定性问题。这两者反映了在FreeBSD系统使用和优化过程中，不同用户根据自身需求和经验对系统修改和包管理方式的不同期望和关注点。

44349949.article_content:
FreeBSD project started to officially add kernel modules
pkg(8)
repositories to default installation – starting with FreeBSD 14.3-RELEASE version.
To understand why they were brought to light of day its first needed to understand the problem they are here to solve.
Problem
This problem does not exists with
x.0
FreeBSD releases – they have all their packages built against proper FreeBSD
x.0
version. The problem arises when
x.1
release is made, or
x.2
… or any OTHER then
x.0
to be precise … but why?
The main problem is that
pkg(8)
packages are built against the currently supported oldest FreeBSD version in the tree. For example when 14.3-RELEASE is announced – the packages for 14.x tree are still built on 14.2-RELEASE for next 3 months since 14.3-RELEASE availability.
This usually does not break any ‘userspace’ applications but kernel modules related packages often are broken and cause kernel panics even on module load – and there are about 70 of them. While FreeBSD team fights really hard to keep ABI and kernel interfaces stable across ‘point’ releases – its sometimes not possible due to the nature of Linux DRM graphics drivers being imported and improved to support more modern GPUs on FreeBSD.
The problem mostly arises in the desktop/laptop area of FreeBSD UNIX usage – as with broken ABI the
drm-kmod
related kernel modules just panic and reboot each such system instantly … and this problem persists for whole 3 months within which the older release is still in support. After these 3 painful months – and after older ‘point’ release is out of support – the
pkg(8)
packages are finally started to built against PROPER latest FreeBSD version – and problem disappears … up to nest ‘point’ release and painful 3 months.
The damage of this policy can be limited with ZFS Boot Environments using tools like
beadm(8)
or
bectl(8)
but its just workaround solution.
Additional Repositories
I have spoken about that problem for years – trying to make FreeBSD project do something about it – for example as there are TWO independent
pkg(8)
branches of packages – the default
quarterly
and optional
latest
one – I suggested to switch
latest
to the LATEST FreeBSD version since day 1 of release and keep
quarterly
as the ‘legacy’ version packages branch … but that proposal did not saw any appreciation.
After many years something different was introduced – additional separate kernel modules related
pkg(8)
repositories – both for
quarterly
and
latest
branches.
Initially they were unofficial and official at the same time. Official for those who follow the FreeBSD project and daily use the
Mailing Lists
–
CFT: Repository for Kernel Modules
– and unofficial for all the others – no mention in the
Release Notes
– no mention in the
Errata
for a FreeBSD release.
Official Solution
In the middle of the FreeBSD 14.3-RELEASE process the situation become more clear as the additional
pkg(8)
repositories became official in the
FreeBSD 14.3-RC1 Now Available
announcement – described as:
o
The default
pkg.conf
file now includes the
FreeBSD-kmods
repository.
Finally.
One may ask – why FreeBSD project will not just use the most easy way and build separate set of packages for each release – the answer is simple and brutal – lack of resources – while FreeBSD remains one of the few really free and freedom powered systems – it comes at a price – you do not often get all the toys for free for playing the ‘freedom’ game.
Upgrade Path
Initially I was skeptical about the repositories – but I started to upgrade one of my systems within ZFS Boot Environment … and I was surprised that
freebsd-update(8)
asks to modify
/etc/pkg/FreeBSD.conf
file with additional
FreeBSD-kmods
repository … finally some good fucking news 🙂
I upgraded and rebooted the FreeBSD system up to the latest and greatest 14.3-RELEASE official version – and everything worked as it should. As I prefer to have more recent version of packages with
latest
branch of
pkg(8)
packages – I also switched to
kmods_latest_${VERSION_MINOR}
for the kernel related packages. For convenience (if needed) I have left the
quarterly
branch commented out.
My
/etc/pkg/FreeBSD.conf
file looks like that right now.
FreeBSD %
cat /etc/pkg/FreeBSD.conf
FreeBSD: {
# url: "pkg+https://pkg.FreeBSD.org/${ABI}/quarterly",
url: "pkg+https://pkg.FreeBSD.org/${ABI}/latest",
mirror_type: "srv",
signature_type: "fingerprints",
fingerprints: "/usr/share/keys/pkg",
enabled: yes
}
FreeBSD-kmods: {
# url: "pkg+https://pkg.FreeBSD.org/${ABI}/kmods_quarterly_${VERSION_MINOR}",
url: "pkg+https://pkg.FreeBSD.org/${ABI}/kmods_latest_${VERSION_MINOR}",
mirror_type: "srv",
signature_type: "fingerprints",
fingerprints: "/usr/share/keys/pkg",
enabled: yes
}
FreeBSD %
pkg repos
FreeBSD: {
url             : "pkg+https://pkg.FreeBSD.org/FreeBSD:14:amd64/latest",
enabled         : yes,
priority        : 0,
mirror_type     : "SRV",
signature_type  : "FINGERPRINTS",
fingerprints    : "/usr/share/keys/pkg"
}

url             : "pkg+https://p

data.title: There's Gold in the Hills
data.author: gmays
data.article_summary: 本文是Josh Jackson所著《The Enduring Wild: A Journey into California’s Public Lands》的节选，介绍了美国土地管理局（BLM）管理的2.45亿英亩公共土地的历史与现状。这些土地虽然为公众所有，但其历史涉及对原住民的掠夺和暴力。BLM土地曾被认为不适合开发或无利可图，导致其长期遭受过度放牧和资源开采的破坏。目前，这些公共土地面临预算削减和出售的风险。作者希望通过亲身探访，讲述这些“剩余土地”的故事，让公众更加了解和珍惜这些资源。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对土地历史所有权和殖民问题的不同看法

不同观点：
• [achillesheels] 认为，现代社会建立在系统性从原住民手中夺取的土地上，批评那些假装忽视通过征服和改良土地推动人类进步的说法。他强调殖民前的土地管理权属于原住民，并暗示当前的社会在忽视这一事实。

• [JKCalhoun] 则关注当前的政治背景，认为公众突然关注土地历史所有权问题与美国政府拟出售公共土地的时机有关。他质疑这种关注是否仅仅是巧合，暗示可能有政治动机在背后。

• [sQL_inject] 反对将原住民理想化为和平爱护自然的形象，指出像科曼奇族这样的原住民部落也曾通过暴力征服和掠夺扩展自己的势力范围。他引用《夏月帝国》一书，强调这些部落并没有私有财产的概念，他们的"管理"方式是通过暴力扩展领土，而非出于高尚的理念。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点之一是原住民在殖民前对土地的管理方式以及他们是否和平。sQL_inject 通过具体历史例子指出某些部落的暴力行为，挑战普遍的和平原住民形象，而 achillesheels 则更关注殖民者对土地的系统性夺取。

• 另一个讨论点是当前社会是否在忽视土地历史的真相。achillesheels 认为存在这种忽视，而 JKCalhoun 则关注政治时机，质疑公众对土地历史所有权问题的突然关注是否与政治议程有关。

• 历史叙述的真实性也是一个潜在的讨论点。sQL_inject 强调历史叙述不应被简单化或理想化，需要考虑具体的历史事实和不同部落的多样性。

Josh Jackson | Longreads | June 12, 2025 | 5,262 words (19 minutes)
“There’s Gold in the Hills” is an adapted excerpt from the book
The Enduring Wild: A Journey into California’s Public Lands
by Josh Jackson, published by Heyday and on sale June 24, 2025.
The BLM—short for the Bureau of Land Management—was established in 1946, when the Department of the Interior merged the General Land Office with the Grazing Service. Today, the BLM is one of four federal agencies that manage public land across the United States, and it manages an astonishing 245 million acres across the western states and Alaska. I was dumbfounded by this number. Two hundred and forty-five million acres? How on earth had I never heard of these lands?
Even the idea of “public lands” wasn’t a concept I fully understood. But as I learned more about them, I came to see public lands as something miraculous. When you consider our national zeal for owning private property, it is astounding we have set aside 618 million acres of federal land for the public. These are areas of land and water that are
owned collectively by the citizens
and managed by the federal government. The concept is worth reiterating: These lands are our common ground, a gift of seismic proportions that belongs to all of us. No matter your color, creed, or class, and even if you’ve never signed your name to a deed, you are a landowner. We are all landowners. Coming to terms with this endowment was a revelation.
Buy this book on
Amazon
or
Booksho
p
Of course, there’s a deeper story behind how these lands became part of the federal domain, and it likely won’t surprise you to learn that it’s an undeniably ugly one. It didn’t take long for me to discover that these lands were systemically stolen from the hands of the Native Americans who had stewarded them for millennia before colonialism in different forms devastated their tribes. Through invasions, plagues, violence, coercion, bribery, war, and lopsided deals with the United States government, Indigenous groups and their ways of life were nearly obliterated. Behind every layer of history I peeled back was a heartbreaking story of loss.
The second distinction that sets BLM lands apart lies in how these leftover lands were perceived and treated. Once they were deemed unsuitable and/or unprofitable for homesteaders, developers, and other federal land agencies, their fate seemed inconsequential. As a result of this perceived inferiority, vast areas of those lands were then severely degraded through both overgrazing and unchecked extraction of coal, gas, oil, and various minerals. Our BLM lands, while managed by a federal agency, were not always protected by it.
BLM lands continue to face threats on all sides. A reconciliation bill currently in Congress proposes firing up to 20 percent of BLM staff and cutting $532 million from the agency’s budget by 2026—devastating blows to a workforce already stretched thin. Meanwhile, efforts to sell off our shared public lands are gaining ground. Some 540,000 acres across Nevada and Utah are on the chopping block, at risk of being handed over to the highest bidder.
Learning about such land-use imbalances and the fragility of these supposedly protected areas was a sobering wake-up call for me, and it intensified my desire to experience these lands firsthand. But despite my growing knowledge, I still struggled to find certain details about BLM land within California, including how curious visitors could access them and what we might find there. The lack of personal narratives made these lands feel distant and disconnected, as though they existed only in the dry facts of government websites. Stories have a way of breathing life into places, helping us connect on a deeper level, but in my BLM research, such accounts were either absent or merely footnotes in major narratives about the West. It was no wonder I hadn’t heard of these lands before.
If these so-called leftover lands had a story to tell, I wanted to play a small part in telling it. So, with camera in hand and notepad in pocket, I hit the road.
We were stuck.
Absolutely, white-knuckle, bare-bones stuck.
To say we were in the middle of nowhere would have been an understatement. The closest town to our west was a full day’s walk. To our east, the nearest outpost was in Nevada, a marathon and a half away. And thanks to smoke from the 2021 Tamarack Fire blowing in from the north and the August daytime heat in the mid-80s, a long walk in either direction would have been a dreaded affair.

• 另一个讨论点是当前社会是否在忽视土地历史的真相。achillesheels 认为存在这种忽视，而 JKCalhoun 则关注政治时机，质疑公众对土地历史所有权问题的突然关注是否与政治议程有关。

• 历史叙述的真实性也是一个潜在的讨论点。sQL_inject 强调历史叙述不应被简单化或理想化，需要考虑具体的历史事实和不同部落的多样性。

data.title: Dynamic YAML with Python computed properties for fusing API workflows and SQL
data.author: maxgrinev
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了一个使用YAML和SQL创建完整API工作流的工具——Sequor。该工具允许用户利用数据库作为处理引擎，通过API拉取数据、使用SQL转换数据，并推送至任何目标平台。通过动态YAML实现快速灵活的开发，支持从简单数据同步到复杂跨应用自动化的扩展。其特点包括：使用YAML定义清晰的工作流结构，支持Jinja模板和Python表达式实现无限定制，内置数据库集成，无需自定义代码。文中还提供了Shopify到Snowflake再到Mailchimp的实际案例，展示了如何快速实现API到API的工作流，并支持多种集成模式和预制模板，帮助用户降低SaaS成本并减少工具扩散。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：针对YAML中使用双花括号语法以及相关技术选择的讨论，以及对工具目标和市场定位的疑问。

不同观点：
• mdaniel：认为默认使用Jinja2风格的双花括号（{{}}）在YAML中会导致很多问题，尤其是在处理引号和表达式嵌套时，会引发"leaning toothpick syndrome"（复杂转义问题）。他建议更改起止符号为${{}}以避免技术债务，并提供了具体的代码修改建议。
• vivzkestrel：对工具的目标受众、用户收益、竞争产品以及商业模式提出了几个基础问题，表现出对该工具定位和市场策略的关注。
• bz_bz_bz：质疑在主要示例中重新计算客户指标是否会浪费Snowflake资源，关注工具的实际性能和资源利用效率。
• maxgrinev：支持动态YAML的使用，认为其在API集成之外也有应用潜力，分享了他们使用Python和JavaScript原型的经验，并寻求对该方法的反馈。

补充讨论：

data.title: Otus Lisp
data.author: smartmic
data.article_summary: Otus Lisp (Ol) 2.6版是一个功能性Lisp方言，实现了R7RS Scheme的扩展子集，包括一些SRFIs。它小巧（约64KB）、嵌入式、跨平台，并提供高层次接口以调用其他语言代码。Ol支持多种操作系统（如Linux、Windows、macOS、Android等）和硬件架构（x86、ARM、MIPS等），也可通过WebAssembly在浏览器中运行。它具有高效的垃圾回收机制和纯函数式语言特性，如延续、尾递归和协程。新功能包括支持传统数学符号的输入法（Infix Notation）。Ol在多个平台和浏览器上进行了测试，并提供MIT和GPLv3双重许可。用户可以在线试用Ol，无需下载安装。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Otus工具的特点及其与编程语言、平台支持相关的讨论。

不同观点：
• mark_l_watson认为Otus看起来是一个不错的工具，类似于Gambit Scheme，且其大部分用Scheme编写，内置的CFFI（C外部函数接口）看起来很好。他表示自己多年享受使用Gambit Scheme及基于Gambit的Scheme，并对Otus表示认可。

• graemep则关注Otus引用的一句被误改的Greenspun名言。他指出Otus版本的表述和原版（关于C或Fortran程序中包含Lisp方言的实现）有显著区别，暗示Otus在语言实现上可能存在不严谨或广告式的表达。

• dleslie指出Otus是R7RS（Scheme语言标准之一）的一个有自己特色的实现，并提供了一个链接，列出了Otus与R7RS标准的多处偏差。这表明Otus虽然遵循R7RS，但在具体实现上做了不少改动。

• fsmv对Otus支持的平台列表表示赞赏，但质疑为什么平台支持止步于486处理器，尤其在已经支持众多平台的情况下，认为至少应该能支持到386处理器，尽管32位可能是一个限制因素。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是Otus对Lisp方言的实现是否严谨。graemep指出了引用中的不准确性，暗示可能存在误导。
• dleslie提供的链接展示了Otus与R7RS标准的具体差异，表明该工具在遵循标准的同时也有自己的独特设计选择。
• fsmv的评论引发了关于平台支持范围的讨论，特别是对老旧硬件的支持及其技术限制。

这些观点共同构成了对Otus工具的多角度评价，包括其语言实现、功能特点以及技术限制等方面。

data.title: USAF B-2 Spirit Bombers Have Beds
data.author: neom
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了美国空军B-2隐形轰炸机的长时间任务执行情况及其机组人员的休息安排。B-2是小型但具备极长航程的轰炸机，机上配有折叠床、微波炉和简易化学厕所，使两名飞行员能在执行超过24小时的任务中轮流休息。文章描述了一次超过40小时的任务，期间飞行员在多次空中加油和改变目标的情况下，持续飞行并完成轰炸任务。相比其他轰炸机如B-1和B-52，B-2因其独特设计和设备，使其能够在长时间任务中提供更好的机组舒适度。这些战略轰炸机共同支撑着美国空军的全球打击能力。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：B-2轰炸机的技术、成本及其军事用途

不同观点：
• **glimshe** 认为B-2轰炸机作为军事飞机，其设计目的是用于伤害和杀戮，但从技术角度看，它们是令人惊叹的工程奇迹。glimshe表达了一种对冷战期间军事技术创新的“罪恶的快感”，希望这些技术奇迹能用于非军事目的。

• **LorenPechtel** 关注B-2轰炸机的技术细节，提到所有具有长时间飞行能力的飞机都配有睡眠设施，暗示B-2轰炸机的长航时能力及其对飞行员舒适性的考虑。

• **cwmoore** 对B-2轰炸机的成本提出评论，指出每架B-2轰炸机20亿美元的造价，并用月食现象类比，暗示这个成本可能并非巧合，可能有隐藏的预算或支出考量。

• **mensetmanusman** 分享了个人经历，提到曾在帕萨迪纳上空看到B-2轰炸机，并感慨自己头顶上的飞机价值10亿美元，强调了B-2轰炸机的高昂成本。

• **bamboozled** 对其他评论者的惊讶表示质疑，似乎认为对B-2轰炸机的高成本或技术能力不应该感到意外，可能暗示对这些方面已有预期或了解。

补充讨论：
- **技术欣赏与道德考量**：glimshe对B-2轰炸机的技术表示赞赏，但同时也表达了一种道德上的复杂情感，认为这些技术如果用于和平目的会更好。
- **成本争议**：cwmoore和mensetmanusman都提到了B-2轰炸机的昂贵造价，cwmoore甚至暗示成本可能有其他隐情，而mensetmanusman则通过个人观察强调了实际感受。
- **技术细节**：LorenPechtel提供了关于长时间飞行飞机的技术细节，补充了讨论中的技术维度。

44350476.article_content:
Sprawled on a canvas bunk less than an arm’s length from a weapons-release switch, the pilots of the B-2 Spirit do their best to get shut eye in the confines of their billion-dollar stealth bomber’s bunk. The mighty
Northrop Grumman
flying wing is among the smaller bombers of the
US Air Force
’s Global Strike Command, but conducts extremely prolonged mission sorties. Naturally, if you have aircrew onboard for more than 24 hours, it makes sense that you want them to rest along the way. Captain Chris “Thunder” Beck, a B-2, and former B-52, pilot told
Defense News
:
“After you do a few long-duration flights, anything under twenty hours doesn’t seem like a big deal.”
Every USAF B-2A carries a fold-down cot, a microwave around the size of a shoebox, and a small chemical toilet. That pocket-sized studio wrapped in radar-absorbent material (RAM) and sitting on top of bombs and jet engines is how two pilots keep the B-2 aloft longer than any other crewed combat aircraft in service. Without the basic amenities of life, the Spirit’s 6,000 NM unrefuelled range would be academic, as would the 40-hour loops from Missouri to Libya and back that they fly.
Flying Forty-Hour Missions
Photo: US Air Force, US National Archives
Former B-2 pilot, Mel Deaile’s mission after the event of September 11, 2001 (as he recounted to
the USO
) began with a four-hour flight from Whiteman AFB to the California coast for air refueling in the “Spirit of America.” The bomber tanked at least three times en route, including over Guam, through the Straits of Malacca, and in the Indian Ocean near Diego Garcia.
Between refuelings, the pilots take turns trying to get a few hours of rest in the modified “cot” behind the two ejection seats. Their journey took over 24 hours, in daylight, until they reached the coast of Pakistan. The mission was bombing runs on multiple targets throughout Afghanistan, and with the extended timeline of their flight profile, 70% of their targets had been changed by the time they arrived in theater.
Close
After spending about 25 hours en route, the strike window was only two hours over enemy territory. The bomber exited the country and headed for the tanker with four smart bombs still onboard. As gas was running low, they orbited in the Arabian Sea waiting for a tanker when they were pinged for and accepted a new target. After another 90 minutes of strike runs, they exited Afghanistan a second time to find a waiting tanker to reach Diego Garcia, the final destination.
Four hours later, the team approached the tiny, remote island, ready to touch land for the first time in 44 hours. The B-52 that landed immediately before us had an emergency upon landing, forcing us to "go around," granting the crew a 15-minute aerial tour of the island. After touching down, a fresh crew of two B-2 pilots climbed onboard, and within 45 minutes, the stealth bomber was airborne for its 30-hour journey back to Missouri.
The Spirit of America and five other B-2s operated for more than 70 hours nonstop during the American retaliatory attacks against terrorists. In a testament to the incredible engineering and design of the aircraft, no aircraft encountered any issues or engine trouble during the first three days. Mel Deaile later retired as a colonel, and his copilot went on to be an F-22 Raptor pilot in the reserves.
Related
A Closer Look: The USAF F-117 Nighthawk's Impact During The Persian Gulf War
The aircraft played a key role in the conflict.
Posts
Bed Or No Bed
Photo: US Air Force, US National Archives
The B-1 Lancer, B-2 Spirit, and B-52 Stratofortress are the strategic heavy bombers of the USAF today. They each fill a unique niche and, as a result, each has a slightly different mission profile and, therefore, a different approach to crew rest. The B-1 usually flies faster strike missions with shorter timelines, which means it is the only one with no permanent bedding installed. Each plane does have a galley. However, the B-2 seems to be the only one with a microwave aboard.
The B-52 has a single bunk for crew rest, which the five-strong aircrew take turns using while aloft. The pilots rotate stations to maintain alertness to the highest degree possible while on extended flights. The B-2 is the only one that a person six feet tall (1.8 m) can stand in, which is appreciated by the aircrew as they fly the longest mission times with the smallest crews.

Each of these powerful warbirds fulfills a different need for a strategic strike that the US Air Force delivers in order to support the armed forces of America and its allies. They may differ in many ways, and the approach to mission execution is dramatically different between each platform, but the ultimate goal is the same, and the joint qualities of this incredible trio make the US Air Force the most powerful strategic air power in the world to date.

data.title: The Void IDE, Open-Source Alternative to Cursor, Released in Beta
data.author: rmason
data.article_summary: Void IDE是一款新发布的beta版开源AI代码编辑器，旨在成为Cursor和GitHub Copilot等闭源AI编辑器的隐私保护替代品。它基于Visual Studio Code，由Y Combinator支持，强调数据隐私，允许开发者在本地或通过直接API调用进行AI处理，避免第三方介入。Void IDE支持多种大型语言模型（如Claude、GPT、Gemini），提供内联代码编辑、AI聊天和代码生成等功能。此外，用户可以迁移VS Code的主题、键绑定和设置。尽管社区对VS Code的频繁分叉存在质疑，但其开源性质和隐私保护特性引起了开发者的兴趣，项目团队鼓励社区贡献以完善其功能。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕基于Visual Studio Code（VS Code）的IDE（集成开发环境）及其替代方案的讨论，特别关注AI辅助编程工具的未来发展方向。

不同观点：
• **CharlesW的观点**：认为以VS Code为基础进行 fork 开发（如 Void IDE）是一种"进化死胡同"。他尝试了多种AI编程工具（如 OpenAI Codex、Google Jules、Claude Code），最终认为没有必要完全替换现有IDE，AI助手应以与流行IDE集成为主，而非完全取代它们。他特别指出Claude Code表现最佳。

• **mlboss的观点**：持不同看法，认为未来可能不再需要传统的IDE。他推崇Claude Code这样的工具，因其在终端运行，能够访问所有终端工具，并且可以编写脚本和执行shell命令，具备取代传统IDE的潜力。

• **Fire-Dragon-DoL的观点**：表达了对现有fork项目（如Cursor编辑器）的不满，认为其使用体验远不如VS Code，存在速度慢、扩展支持差、无法同步设置等问题。他曾寄希望于GitHub Copilot以重回VS Code的使用。

• **bezerius的观点**：简短指出GitHub Copilot是开源的，但没有详细阐述其对IDE讨论的具体立场，可能意在提醒大家关注Copilot的开源属性。

补充讨论：
• **争议的焦点**：是否需要完全替换现有的IDE（如VS Code），还是通过AI工具与现有IDE集成来提高开发效率。CharlesW和mlboss的观点形成鲜明对比，前者支持集成，后者则认为未来可能无需IDE。

• **工具表现**：Claude Code被CharlesW和mlboss认为是表现较好的AI编程工具，尤其是在终端环境下的多功能性受到mlboss的高度评价。

• **用户体验问题**：Fire-Dragon-DoL强调了fork项目在用户体验上的不足，特别是与VS Code相比的差距，这可能影响开发者对新工具的接受度。

• **开源属性**：bezerius提到的GitHub Copilot的开源属性可能在讨论中具有一定的重要性，尤其是在选择工具时，开源性可能影响开发者的决策。

A new open-source AI-powered code editor,
Void IDE
, was recently
released in beta
, positioning itself as a privacy-focused and free alternative to popular closed-source AI editors like Cursor and GitHub Copilot. Backed by Y Combinator, Void IDE is a fork of Visual Studio Code. While Microsoft recently
announced plans to open Source its GitHub Copilot Chat Extension
possibly in a few months, the beta release is available now for the community to fiddle with.
The primary motivation behind Void IDE is to address concerns surrounding the privacy and cost associated with proprietary AI coding tools. Closed-source editors may require sending private code data through their backends, raising privacy issues and leading to ongoing subscription costs. While the backend may often
keep only embeddings computed from the code
, the original code may sometimes be recoverable. As the authors of the paper
Mitigating Privacy Risks in LLM Embeddings from Embedding Inversion
explain:
The surge in popularity of embedding vector databases in LLMs has been accompanied by significant concerns about privacy leakage. Embedding vector databases are particularly vulnerable to embedding inversion attacks, where adversaries can exploit the embeddings to reverse-engineer and extract sensitive information from the original text data.
Void IDE aims to provide options for keeping developers in control of their data.  Void IDE can leverage various Large Language Models (LLMs), supporting direct integrations with services like Claude, GPT, and Gemini, as well as
local model hosting via Ollama
. This ensures that
AI processing can happen locally or via direct API calls, avoiding a third-party middleman
.
Void IDE offers a range of AI-centric features familiar to users of tools like Cursor. These include inline code editing, contextual AI chat, and code generation.  The editor also features advanced capabilities like file system awareness for codebase-wide context and the ability to view/edit the underlying prompts sent to the AI.
Being a fork from VS Code, Void IDE is able to let its users
migrate their themes, key bindings, and settings
.
Developers on
Hacker News
and
Reddit
expressed interest, particularly regarding its open-source nature and privacy stance. Discussions include comparisons to other AI coding tools and editors. Some developers
expressed skepticism
about the
proliferation of VS Code forks
, with others asking
why not
use an
extension instead
. The project is actively developed, with the team
encouraging contributions from the community to shape its future roadmap
.

data.title: Children in England growing up 'sedentary, scrolling and alone', say experts
data.author: PaulHoule
data.article_summary: 一项由Raising the Nation Play Commission进行的调查发现，英格兰的儿童因户外游戏空间减少，变得久坐、沉迷手机且孤独。专家建议禁止“禁止球类活动”的标志，将数字年龄 consent 提高到16岁，恢复教育系统中的游戏，并要求地方政府承担法定的“保障游戏充足性”责任。专家呼吁制定国家游戏策略，每年提供1.25亿英镑的资金支持。调查显示，街道交通繁忙、青少年俱乐部减少以及游乐场资金不足是导致儿童户外游戏空间减少的主要原因。儿童和家长也反映，可用的游戏空间有限、昂贵或被移除，学校内的游戏时间不足进一步加剧了问题。专家强调，必须采取行动改善儿童的游戏环境。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：青少年使用数字设备和户外活动的现状及其影响

不同观点：
• **[martinald]** 认为数字设备和互联网的使用可以为孩子提供学习技术内容和结识全球朋友的机会，这对于其职业发展和兴趣培养有积极作用。他指出，如果对计算机使用时间进行限制，可能会影响青少年的发展轨迹。虽然无意义地刷视频确实效用较低，但不能忽视通过互联网发现兴趣和热情的机会。

• **[throw_lfnsooemd]** 强调青少年在12至18岁之间缺乏户外活动的机会，尤其是在英国，许多青少年没有经济能力参与需要付费的活动，也无法进入酒吧等场所。由于户外活动的匮乏，青少年只能选择待在室内探索数字世界。这使得他们通过数字手段体验世界成为一种平等的方式，但也反映出户外活动选项的匮乏。

• **[mensetmanusman]** 提出一种文化视角，讨论了无尽娱乐对某些文化的“毁灭性”影响，尤其是在人口统计学意义上。这暗示了数字娱乐可能导致某些文化的消失或转型。

• **[ryao]** 从个人经历出发，认为久坐、独自刷屏的童年对曾经历过校园暴力的孩子来说可能是理想的。对于这些孩子来说，社交并不总是积极的，他们可能更倾向于避免面对面的社交互动。

• **[OgsyedIE]** 指出，将责任完全归咎于父母是不合理的，认为系统性问题导致了父母对子女福祉的忽视。讨论了这种现象是否源于某种意识形态，或者相反。

• **[hackernoops]** 和 **[theyknowitsxmas]** 的评论带有较为偏激的个人观点，前者提到青少年可能因暴力事件而选择待在室内，后者则通过提及过去的游戏暗示现代青少年失去了某些传统活动。

• **[mschuster91]** 补充了关于“直升机育儿”的讨论，指出随着家庭规模缩小和育儿压力的增加，父母更倾向于保护孩子免受外界危险。现代社会的经济不安全和媒体的恐惧宣传使得户外育儿变得困难。

• **[mouse_]** 强调城市环境中的孩子缺乏安全的户外活动空间，指出在城市环境中“外面没有地方玩”，孩子只能选择待在室内。

• **[markus_zhang]** 持有一种适应论的观点，认为经过几代人后，社会将适应新的常态，青少年使用数字设备的现象将成为普遍接受的事实。

补充讨论：
- 争议的焦点在于数字设备对青少年发展的影响，尤其是户外活动机会的减少与数字世界的吸引力之间的平衡。
- 讨论还涉及父母育儿的责任和系统性压力，包括经济不安全、媒体的恐惧宣传以及对孩子安全的担忧如何影响育儿方式。
- 部分评论提到了个人经历和文化视角，强调了不同个体和文化背景下对数字设备和户外活动的不同看法。

Children's health
Children in England growing up ‘sedentary, scrolling and alone’, say experts
Raising the Nation Play Commission report recommends ban on ‘no ball games’ signs and raising digital age of consent to 16
‘The impact has been profound’: the headteacher bringing play back to the classroom
Harriet Grant
Wed 11 Jun 2025 00.00 EDT
Last modified on Wed 11 Jun 2025 05.33 EDT
Share
Children are growing up “sedentary, scrolling and alone” because of a dramatic decline in play in their lives, say a panel of experts who have spent a year investigating play and childhood in England.
The government should ban “no ball games” signs, raise the digital age of consent to 16, restore play to the education system and put in place
a statutory “play sufficiency duty” for local authorities
, say the panel, who are urgently calling for a cross-departmental national play strategy backed by an annual £125m of funding.
The experts leading the Raising the Nation Play Commission report, the entrepreneur Paul Lindley and former children’s commissioner Anne Longfield, say that failure to provide children with the spaces they need outside the home is leading to a huge loss of outdoor play and independence.
Lady Longfield, executive chair of the Centre for Young Lives, said: “Too many of our children are spending their most precious years sedentary, doomscrolling on their phones and often alone, while their health and wellbeing deteriorates. It is no coincidence that the least happy generation, the generation with the highest rates of obesity and rising ill health, is the generation that plays less and less.
The commission brought together 19 experts, from doctors to play campaigners, to act as commissioners and then held a series of evidence sessions hearing from children, parents and professionals around the country.
One of the key arguments experts made is that the rise in time spent on smartphones and gaming devices is being driven not just by the ubiquity of screens themselves, but by the loss of alternative ways and places for children to play.
From traffic-dominated streets to the huge decline in youth clubs and loss of funds for playgrounds, experts pointed to the decline in neighbourhood spaces where children could actually play freely.
Ingrid Skeels, co-director of Playing Out, was one of the 19 commissioners and has spent 15 years campaigning for children to have safer streets to play on.
Children in England’s most deprived areas ‘less likely to achieve development goals by age five’
Read more
“The findings here confirm what we have been warning for years – children are being driven indoors by a lack of safe spaces to play, move and socialise freely. We can’t just blame overprotective parents and screens – we have to make the outside world a place children can play in real life. It’s brilliant to have this in-depth, rigorous report confirm what we have heard from families for years, now it’s time for action.”
Children themselves also gave their thoughts to the commission through a youth panel.
A girl in year 7 in London told the commission that children should go outside and be exposed to some risks, saying: “If you don’t let your child out at some point, your child is never gonna learn … parents should give their children a bit more freedom and free will so that children will be aware of the real world.”
Young people described local play spaces that are limited, costly, or have been removed. “There’s not much to do and the things that there are cost a lot of money,” said one panellist.
Children also repeatedly told the panel that there isn’t enough time in the schoolday to play, and described how school work dominated life outside too. “The reason we don’t have time to play”, one year 7 child said, “is because we’ve got stress, we’re doing homework. All the homework Monday to Friday, we’ve got massive lines […] at lunch and break with barely any time to do anything. I feel like we should have a bit longer so we have more time to go outside and stuff”.

不同观点：
• **[martinald]** 认为数字设备和互联网的使用可以为孩子提供学习技术内容和结识全球朋友的机会，这对于其职业发展和兴趣培养有积极作用。他指出，如果对计算机使用时间进行限制，可能会影响青少年的发展轨迹。虽然无意义地刷视频确实效用较低，但不能忽视通过互联网发现兴趣和热情的机会。

• **[throw_lfnsooemd]** 强调青少年在12至18岁之间缺乏户外活动的机会，尤其是在英国，许多青少年没有经济能力参与需要付费的活动，也无法进入酒吧等场所。由于户外活动的匮乏，青少年只能选择待在室内探索数字世界。这使得他们通过数字手段体验世界成为一种平等的方式，但也反映出户外活动选项的匮乏。

• **[mensetmanusman]** 提出一种文化视角，讨论了无尽娱乐对某些文化的“毁灭性”影响，尤其是在人口统计学意义上。这暗示了数字娱乐可能导致某些文化的消失或转型。

• **[ryao]** 从个人经历出发，认为久坐、独自刷屏的童年对曾经历过校园暴力的孩子来说可能是理想的。对于这些孩子来说，社交并不总是积极的，他们可能更倾向于避免面对面的社交互动。

• **[OgsyedIE]** 指出，将责任完全归咎于父母是不合理的，认为系统性问题导致了父母对子女福祉的忽视。讨论了这种现象是否源于某种意识形态，或者相反。

• **[hackernoops]** 和 **[theyknowitsxmas]** 的评论带有较为偏激的个人观点，前者提到青少年可能因暴力事件而选择待在室内，后者则通过提及过去的游戏暗示现代青少年失去了某些传统活动。

• **[mschuster91]** 补充了关于“直升机育儿”的讨论，指出随着家庭规模缩小和育儿压力的增加，父母更倾向于保护孩子免受外界危险。现代社会的经济不安全和媒体的恐惧宣传使得户外育儿变得困难。

• **[mouse_]** 强调城市环境中的孩子缺乏安全的户外活动空间，指出在城市环境中“外面没有地方玩”，孩子只能选择待在室内。

• **[markus_zhang]** 持有一种适应论的观点，认为经过几代人后，社会将适应新的常态，青少年使用数字设备的现象将成为普遍接受的事实。

data.title: Tiny orange beads found by Apollo astronauts reveal Moon's explosive past
data.author: anigbrowl
data.article_summary: 阿波罗宇航员在月球上发现了微小的橙色玻璃珠，这些珠子形成于33至36亿年前的火山喷发，揭示了月球过去的剧烈地质活动。这些珠子是在火山喷发时被抛向空中，迅速冷却凝固而成。借助现代先进技术，科学家们对这些珠子进行了详细分析，发现月球的火山喷发风格随时间发生了变化。研究使用了纳米二次离子质谱仪等多种技术，避免了珠子在与地球大气接触中受到影响。这些珠子为研究月球内部和古代火山活动提供了重要线索，展示了月球动态的地质历史。研究成果发表在《Icarus》期刊上。

44350717.article_content:
Science News
from research organizations
Tiny orange beads found by Apollo astronauts reveal moon’s explosive past
Date:
June 16, 2025
Source:
Washington University in St. Louis
Summary:
When Apollo astronauts stumbled across shimmering orange beads on the moon, they had no idea they were gazing at ancient relics of violent volcanic activity. These glass spheres, tiny yet mesmerizing, formed billions of years ago during fiery eruptions that launched molten droplets skyward, instantly freezing in space. Now, using advanced instruments that didn't exist in the 1970s, scientists have examined the beads in unprecedented detail. The result is a remarkable window into the moon s dynamic geological history, revealing how eruption styles evolved and how lunar conditions once mirrored explosive events we see on Earth today.
Share:

Twitter
Pinterest
LinkedIN
Email
FULL STORY
Apollo astronauts found vivid glass beads on the moon — signs of explosive volcanic activity from 3.5 billion years ago. With cutting-edge tools, researchers are now decoding these tiny time capsules to learn how the moon's eruptions changed over time. Credit: NASA
The Apollo astronauts didn't know what they'd find when they explored the surface of the moon, but they certainly didn't expect to see drifts of tiny, bright orange glass beads glistening among the otherwise monochrome piles of rocks and dust.
The beads, each less than 1 mm across, formed some 3.3 to 3.6 billion years ago during volcanic eruptions on the surface of the then-young satellite. "They're some of the most amazing extraterrestrial samples we have," said Ryan Ogliore, an associate professor of physics in Arts & Sciences at Washington University in St. Louis, home to a large repository of lunar samples that were returned to Earth. "The beads are tiny, pristine capsules of the lunar interior."
Using a variety of microscopic analysis techniques not available when the Apollo astronauts first returned samples from the moon, Ogliore and a team of researchers have been able to take a close look at the microscopic mineral deposits on the outside of lunar beads. The unprecedented view of the ancient lunar artifacts was published in
Icarus
. The investigation was led by Thomas Williams, Stephen Parman and Alberto Saal from Brown University.
The study relied, in part, on the NanoSIMS 50, an instrument at WashU that uses a high-energy ion beam to break apart small samples of material for analysis. WashU researchers have used the device for decades to study interplanetary dust particles, presolar grains in meteorites, and other small bits of debris from our solar system.
The study combined a variety of techniques -- atom probe tomography, scanning electron microscopy, transmission electron microscopy and energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy -- at other institutions to get a closer look at the surface of the beads. "We've had these samples for 50 years, but we now have the technology to fully understand them," Ogliore said. "Many of these instruments would have been unimaginable when the beads were first collected."
As Ogliore explained, each glass bead tells its own story of the moon's past. The beads -- some shiny orange, some glossy black -- formed when lunar volcanoes shot material from the interior to the surface, where each drop of lava solidified instantly in the cold vacuum that surrounds the moon. "The very existence of these beads tells us the moon had explosive eruptions, something like the fire fountains you can see in Hawaii today," he said. Because of their origins, the beads have a color, shape and chemical composition unlike anything found on Earth.
Tiny minerals on the surface of the beads could react with oxygen and other components of Earth's atmosphere. To avoid this possibility, the researchers extracted beads from deep within samples and kept them protected from air exposure through every step of the analysis. "Even with the advanced techniques we used, these were very difficult measurements to make," Ogliore said.
The minerals (including zinc sulfides) and isotopic composition of the bead surfaces serve as probes into the different pressure, temperature and chemical environment of lunar eruptions 3.5 billion years ago. Analyses of orange and black lunar beads have shown that the style of volcanic eruptions changed over time. "It's like reading the journal of an ancient lunar volcanologist," Ogliore said.

data.title: PostmarketOS v25.06: The One with Systemd
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: postmarketOS v25.06引入了systemd，主要面向Linux爱好者，注重稳定性改进和自动化测试，但尚未达到Android或iOS的完善程度。该版本基于Alpine Linux 3.22，并在用户界面、软件堆栈等方面进行了多项更新。GNOME 48和KDE Plasma Mobile 6.3.5提供了性能和功能上的显著改进，Phosh 0.47.0增加了锁屏壁纸等功能，Sxmo 1.17.1仍使用OpenRC，但可通过pmbootstrap构建systemd版本。新版本还包括一个os-installer UI，用于简化安装过程，并引入了mobile-config-thunderbird和mobile-config-firefox以优化Thunderbird和Firefox的移动体验。相机支持已添加到OnePlus 6和多个MSM89x7设备中，音频和充电支持也已扩展。感谢众多贡献者的努力。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：PostmarketOS在放弃systemd后的维护及其作为手机操作系统的潜力

不同观点：
• [反对使用systemd] greatgib认为，PostmarketOS放弃systemd是一个退步。他指出，开发者为了保持兼容性而不使用systemd，但这样做会损害PostmarketOS成为手机上严肃替代品的潜力。他强调systemd在嵌入式设备上的不适用性，认为它不关心嵌入式环境的灵活性和效率。

• [支持systemd的必要性] 隐含的观点是，虽然开发者努力在没有systemd的情况下进行维护，但systemd在某些方面（如兼容性和维护的便利性）可能有其不可替代的优势，尤其是在考虑将PostmarketOS作为手机操作系统时，systemd的支持可能至关重要。

补充讨论：
• greatgib对嵌入式系统和灵活性的关注表明，对于某些用户和开发者来说，systemd可能被视为一种过于庞大和复杂的解决方案，而PostmarketOS在没有systemd的情况下，虽然更灵活和高效，但可能失去了一些兼容性和可维护性的优势。

• 争议的焦点在于是否应该为了嵌入式系统的灵活性和效率而完全放弃systemd，还是应该找到一种方法在保留systemd优势的同时满足嵌入式设备的需求。

We are working hard on stability improvements and
automated testing
, but if you expect Android or iOS levels of polish, then this is not for you yet.
Introduction
This is it, the one that adds systemd to postmarketOS! We have talked about the decision at length on this blog, make sure to read

As always we target the most recent Alpine release. In case of v25.06 it is the excellent
Alpine Linux 3.22
.
User Interfaces (UIs)
Mobile UI Versions
GNOME 48
and
gnome-shell-mobile 48.mobile.0
replace GNOME 47 and 46-mobile.1 from v24.12. With the new versions we get massive performance improvements with dynamic triple buffering and more, new fonts, notification stacking, window placement and input improvements and much more. Thanks to
Jonas
, Achill and all the GNOME contributors!
KDE Plasma Mobile 6.3.5
replaces version 6.2.4 from v24.12. This release has improvements for the task switcher, window placement, action drawer, quick settings, status bar, volume controls, manual screen rotation, a new traffic monitor in the Wi-Fi settings and major bug fixes regarding the lockscreen and dual-sim devices. The new chat page has gotten
new UX

, Bart and all the KDE contributors!
Phosh 0.47.0
replaces version 0.45.0 from v24.12. Between these releases, Phosh has gained support for setting a lockscreen wallpaper (which we have enabled in pmOS), quick settings improvements, searching in the file chooser portal and adjusting haptic strength in the settings. In postmarketOS we have changed the default on-screen-keyboard to
Stevia
. See the
edge post
if you want to keep using squeekboard. Stevia supports
word completion
,
character popover
and a lot more! Thanks to
Guido
, Stefan, Achill and all the Phosh contributors!
Sxmo stays on the fine
1.17.1
release. Unlike other UIs listed above, the pre-built images use OpenRC. With that being said you can build your own systemd-based Sxmo image by using
pmbootstrap
and applying some
manual tweaks
(which future Sxmo releases will have out of the box). Thanks to
Anjan
,
Maarten
,
Willow
,
ArenM
and all the Sxmo contributors!
Wallpaper
Once again we had a lot of fun browsing through the amazing wallpapers that
dikasp
created for postmarketOS, narrowed them down to a short list of only four and created a
Mastodon poll
where the final wallpaper was chosen. The winner is
Evergreen
with 164/330 votes and lovely comments like
"because it's pmOS logo-themed"
and
"because I like triangles"
. Find previous wallpapers
in the wiki
. Thanks dikasp!
Other Notable Changes
A new
os-installer
UI is now available, which has the primary use case of making installations on laptops, netbooks and convertibles easier. Grab a pre-built image or build your own one with this UI, flash it to a USB stick, boot it, and then create an
encrypted
installation on the internal storage. Thanks Clayton!

mobile-config-thunderbird
for the first time, which —
you guessed it
— can be used to turn the amazing desktop version of Thunderbird into a mobile friendly Linux Mobile app. Thanks Dylan!

on the other hand has received many UI fixes and improvements as well as per-site user-agent spoofing to make e.g. YouTube use its proper mobile site. Thanks
Danny

Peter
and people working on furios-firefox-tweaks!

• greatgib对嵌入式系统和灵活性的关注表明，对于某些用户和开发者来说，systemd可能被视为一种过于庞大和复杂的解决方案，而PostmarketOS在没有systemd的情况下，虽然更灵活和高效，但可能失去了一些兼容性和可维护性的优势。

• 争议的焦点在于是否应该为了嵌入式系统的灵活性和效率而完全放弃systemd，还是应该找到一种方法在保留systemd优势的同时满足嵌入式设备的需求。

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：LLM（大型语言模型）在编程和软件开发中的应用及其局限性

不同观点：
• furyofantares 认为，使用LLM（如Claude Code）进行编程可以加快初期开发速度（vibe coding），但随着项目规模扩大，LLM对代码库的整体掌控力下降，开发者仍需成为代码专家。最终，人类对LLM的有效引导是关键技能，而非完全依赖LLM生成代码。

• gwynforthewyn 怀疑有关LLM高效开发的说法，认为这些讨论往往缺乏实际成果展示，并暗示可能存在误导性宣传。
• sieve 分享了LLM在非编程任务（如文本处理和比较）中的不稳定表现，指出LLM在处理复杂任务时可能会出现错误，且需要大量人工干预。

• falcor84 引用了Kent Beck的观点，认为LLM使得一些技能的价值大幅下降，而其他技能（如系统设计）的价值则显著提升。

• 争议的焦点在于LLM在编程中的实际效果和应用价值。一些人认为LLM可以大幅提高开发效率，而另一些人则对其能力持怀疑态度，认为高级技能和人类监督仍然不可或缺。

data.author: cantdutchthis
data.article_summary: Chris Lattner宣布Python现在可以调用Mojo代码，这是一种简单的编译语言，能够为Python提供更快的函数。通过使用`uv`工具安装Mojo模块，开发者可以在`.mojo`文件中定义函数并从Python调用。示例展示了如何在Mojo中实现阶乘和质数计数函数，并与Python和NumPy的实现进行比较。结果显示，Mojo在某些计算任务上明显更快，例如质数计数函数比Python快约40倍。尽管目前Mojo仍处于早期阶段，存在一些粗糙之处，如大数计算时的溢出问题，但其潜力巨大，特别是在需要高性能函数的场景下。Mojo相较于Rust更易学，为Python开发者提供了强大的性能提升工具。

44331316.article_content:
Python can run Mojo now
2025-06-17
Chris Lattner
mentioned
that Python can actually call Mojo code now. I love this idea (!) as I'm definitely in the market for a simple compiled language that can offer Python some really fast functions. So I gave it a quick spin
Setup
The setup is much simpler than I remember it, you can use
uv
for it now.
uv pip install modular --index-url https://dl.modular.com/public/nightly/python/simple/
After that you can declare a
.mojo
file that looks like this:
# mojo_module.mojo
from python import PythonObject
from python.bindings import PythonModuleBuilder
import math
from os import abort
@export
fn PyInit_mojo_module() -> PythonObject:
try:
var m = PythonModuleBuilder("mojo_module")
m.def_function[factorial]("factorial", docstring="Compute n!")
return m.finalize()
except e:
return abort[PythonObject](String("error creating Python Mojo module:", e))
fn factorial(py_obj: PythonObject) raises -> PythonObject:
# Raises an exception if `py_obj` is not convertible to a Mojo `Int`.
var n = Int(py_obj)
var result = 1
for i in range(1, n + 1):
result *= i
return result
And you can then load it from Python via:
# main.py
import max.mojo.importer
import os
import sys
import time
import math
sys.path.insert(0, "")
import mojo_module
start = time.time()
print(mojo_module.factorial(10))
end = time.time()
print(f"Time taken: {end - start} seconds for mojo")
start = time.time()
print(math.factorial(10))
end = time.time()
print(f"Time taken: {end - start} seconds for python")
This was the output:
3628800
Time taken: 3.0279159545898438e-05 seconds for mojo
3628800
Time taken: 5.0067901611328125e-06 seconds for python
This all works, but at the time of making this blogpost I was able to spot some rough edges. If I increase the factorial number to 100 then the output changes.
0
Time taken: 2.7894973754882812e-05 seconds for mojo
188267717688892609974376770249160085759540364871492425887598231508353156331613598866882932889495923133646405445930057740630161919341380597818883457558547055524326375565007131770880000000000000000000000000000000
Time taken: 9.298324584960938e-06 seconds for python
This is probably because of some overflow issues on the modular side. The docs mention that this whole stack is pretty early, and I guess this is a sign of that.
Another example
Given that the overflow is probably the issue here, I figured I'd run one extra example just to see if we could measure a speed increase. So I went with a naive prime number counting example. This is the mojo code:
from python import PythonObject
from python.bindings import PythonModuleBuilder
import math
from os import abort
@export
fn PyInit_mojo_module() -> PythonObject:
try:
var m = PythonModuleBuilder("mojo_module")
m.def_function[count_primes]("count_primes", docstring="Count primes up to n")
return m.finalize()
except e:
return abort[PythonObject](String("error creating Python Mojo module:", e))
fn count_primes(py_obj: PythonObject) raises -> PythonObject:
var n = Int(py_obj)
var count: Int = 0
for i in range(2, n + 1):
var is_prime: Bool = True
for j in range(2, i):
if i % j == 0:
is_prime = False
break
if is_prime:
count += 1
return count
This is the Python code, note that I also added a numpy implementation for comparison.
import numpy as np
import max.mojo.importer
import os
import sys
import time
import math
sys.path.insert(0, "")
import mojo_module
def count_primes(n):
count = 0
for i in range(2, n + 1):
is_prime = True
for j in range(2, i):
if i % j == 0:
is_prime = False
break
if is_prime:
count += 1
return count
def count_primes_numpy(n):
if n < 2:
return 0
candidates = np.arange(2, n + 1)
is_prime_mask = np.ones(len(candidates), dtype=bool)
# For each position in our candidates array
for idx, candidate in enumerate(candidates):
if candidate == 2:  # 2 is prime
continue
# Create divisors array [2, 3, ..., candidate-1]
divisors = np.arange(2, candidate)
# Vectorized divisibility check
has_divisor = np.any(candidate % divisors == 0)
if has_divisor:
is_prime_mask[idx] = False
return np.sum(is_prime_mask)
n = 20_000
start = time.time()
print(count_primes(n))
end = time.time()
print(f"Time taken: {end - start} seconds for python")
start = time.time()
print(count_primes_numpy(n))
end = time.time()
print(f"Time taken: {end - start} seconds for numpy")
start = time.time()
print(mojo_module.count_primes(n))
end = time.time()
print(f"Time taken: {end - start} seconds for mojo")
The results look promising!
2262
Time taken: 0.44585609436035156 seconds for python
2262
Time taken: 0.25995898246765137 seconds for numpy
2262
Time taken: 0.011101961135864258 seconds for mojo
There are better algorithms for prime counting compared to what I am doing here, so take this with a truck of salt, but this is
very
exciting. Mojo is a lot easier to learn than Rust, but I seem to get the function speedup that I want (need).
At the time of writing the main downside is that the modular stack is still
early
, but there also seems to be light support for

data.title: Polystate: Composable Finite State Machines
data.author: goless
data.article_summary:
**Polystate: 可组合的有限状态机**

Polystate是一个用于构建和操作可组合有限状态机（FSM）的库，通过类型组合实现状态机的可组合性与类型安全。其核心设计理念包括：

1. **类型级状态记录**：通过类型系统记录状态机的状态。
2. **可组合性**：通过类型组合实现状态机的模块化与复用。
3. **简化复杂状态机构建**：通过简单的状态组合构建复杂的状态机，实现语义级别的代码复用。
4. **自动生成状态图**：基于声明自动生成状态图，帮助用户直观理解程序行为。

使用步骤：
1. 通过命令 `zig fetch --save git+https://github.com/sdzx-1/polystate.git` 添加依赖。
2. 在 `build.zig` 中声明依赖并导入模块。
3. 通过组合简单状态构建复杂状态机，定义全局行为。

How to use polystate?
Writing this document was more difficult than I anticipated. Although I have been writing and using this library for a while, it's not easy to explain it clearly to others. If you have any questions after reading this document, please don't hesitate to ask. I'd be happy to clear up any confusion!
Polystate's Core Design Philosophy
Record the state machine's status at the type level.
Achieve composable state machines through type composition.
Finite State Machines (FSMs) are a powerful programming pattern. When combined with composability and type safety, they become an even more ideal programming paradigm.
The
polystate
library is designed precisely for this purpose. To achieve this, you need to follow a few simple programming conventions. These conventions are very straightforward, and the benefits they bring are entirely worth it.
Practical Effects of Polystate
Define the program's overall behavior through compositional declarations.
This means we gain the ability to specify the program's overall behavior at the type level. This significantly improves the correctness of imperative program structures. This programming style also encourages us to redesign the program's state from the perspective of types and composition, thereby enhancing code composability.
Build complex state machines by composing simple states.
For the first time, we can achieve semantic-level code reuse through type composition. In other words, we have found a way to express semantic-level code reuse at the type level. This approach achieves three effects simultaneously: conciseness, correctness, and safety.
Automatically generate state diagrams.
Since the program's overall behavior is determined by declarations,
polystate
can automatically generate state diagrams. Users can intuitively understand the program's overall behavior through these diagrams.
I believe all of this represents a great step forward for imperative programming!

Polystate是一个用于构建和操作可组合有限状态机（FSM）的库，通过类型组合实现状态机的可组合性与类型安全。其核心设计理念包括：

4. **自动生成状态图**：基于声明自动生成状态图，帮助用户直观理解程序行为。

3. 通过组合简单状态构建复杂状态机，定义全局行为。

Polystate提供了两个核心类型：FST（状态机类型）和GST（全局状态类型）。FST为枚举类型，定义状态机所有状态；GST为结构体，存储全局数据。状态处理函数可访问GST，但应仅使用与当前状态相关的数据。

该库旨在提高命令式编程的正确性和代码可组合性，是有限状态机编程的理想选择。

data.title: Adobe Project Indigo is a new photo app from former Pixel camera engineers
data.author: bookofjoe
data.article_summary: Adobe推出了一款名为Project Indigo的iPhone相机应用，由前Google团队开发，结合了计算摄影技术，旨在解决智能手机相机控制有限和过度处理的问题。该应用提供自然的效果，而非“零处理”，并包含手动控制和AI功能，如“去除反射”。Project Indigo通过轻微色调映射和组合多达32帧来提升图像质量，支持生成JPEG或RAW文件。该应用目前可免费下载，适用于iPhone 12 Pro及以上机型，Android版本将在未来推出。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：用户对iPhone上的某款相机应用（可能为Indigo）的性能、功能及体验的讨论，涉及与其他设备的对比、应用的优缺点以及一些技术问题。

不同观点：
• [mrtksn] 认为该应用让iPhone 14 Pro表现不足，导致手机过热，甚至让背景音乐播放中断。不过，尽管应用导致性能问题，照片质量依然出色，只是Apple的处理风格有些无聊，因此他有时使用Halide获取未经处理的RAW格式照片。
• [Brajeshwar] 推荐了Leica LUX作为替代应用，尤其是对于那些无法负担Leica实体相机的人。
• [jrgaston] 认为该应用并不能替代DSLR，尽管它在控制和设置上比iPhone默认相机应用更灵活，但使用时手机过热问题明显。
• [stlava] 对该应用的体验非常失望，甚至因此重新使用旧的DSLR相机。
• [modeless] 提到了Marc Levoy的背景，强调他不仅是工程师，还是知名的计算机图形学研究员和斯坦福大学的荣誉教授，暗示其在摄影技术领域的权威性。
• [thedougd] 提到他的手机（不明确型号）不支持该应用，这是他首次遇到这种情况。
• [jeroenhd] 在iPhone 15上运行该应用，遇到过热和处理时间长的问题，认为结果与默认相机应用差不多，并表示更喜欢Pixel的照片。
• [dwayne_dibley] 抱怨文章内容空洞，认为只是广告和填充文字，价值不高。

• [coolandsmartrr] 指出该应用在日本App Store无法下载。

争议焦点：
• 该应用是否能替代DSLR，一些用户认为其表现接近专业相机，而另一些用户则认为远远不及。

Read full article
ian carlos campbell
Contributing Reporter
Updated
Wed, Jun 18, 2025, 5:34 PM
·
2 min read
0
Adobe / Engadget
Adobe launched its own take on how smartphone cameras should work this week with
Project Indigo
, a new iPhone camera app from some of the team behind the Pixel camera. The project combines the
computational photography
techniques that engineers Marc Levoy and Florian Kainz popularized at Google, with pro controls and new AI-powered features.
In their
announcement
of the new app, Levoy and Kainz style Project Indigo as the better answer to typical smartphone camera complaints of limited controls and over-processing. Rather than using aggressive tone mapping and sharpening, Project Indigo is supposed to use "only mild tone mapping, boosting of color saturation, and sharpening." That's intentionally not the same as the
"zero-processing"
approach some third-party apps are taking. "Based on our conversations with photographers, what they really want is not zero-process but a more natural look — more like what an SLR might produce," Levoy and Kainz write.
Adobe
The new app also has fully manual controls, "and the highest image quality that computational photography can provide," whether you want a JPEG or a RAW file at the end. Project Indigo achieves that by dramatically under-exposing the shots it combines together, and relying on a larger number of shots to combine — up to 32 frames, according to Levoy and Kainz. The app also includes some of Adobe's more
experimental photo features
, like "Remove Reflections," which uses AI to eliminate reflections from photos.
ADVERTISEMENT
Advertisement
Levoy
left Google in 2020
, and
joined Adobe
a few months later to form a team with the express goal of building a "universal camera app". Based on
his LinkedIn
, Kainz joined Adobe that same year. At Google, Kainz and Levoy were often credited with popularizing the concept of computational photography, where camera apps rely more on software than hardware to produce quality smartphone photos. Google's success in that arena kicked off a camera arms race that's raised the bar everywhere, but also led to some pretty over-the-top photos. Project Indigo is a bit of a corrective, and also an interesting test whether a third-party app that might produce better photos is enough to beat the default.
Project Indigo is available to download for free now, and runs on either the iPhone 12 Pro and up, or the iPhone 14 and up. An Android version of the app is coming at some point in the future.

data.title: Tensor Manipulation Unit (TMU): Reconfigurable, Near-Memory, High-Throughput AI
data.author: transpute
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了一种名为张量操作单元（Tensor Manipulation Unit, TMU）的可重构近内存硬件模块，旨在高效执行以数据移动为主的张量操作。TMU采用类似RISC的执行模型和统一寻址抽象，支持粗粒度和细粒度张量转换。该设计集成在高吞吐量AI系统级芯片（SoC）中，利用双缓冲和输出转发提高流水线利用率。在SMIC 40nm工艺下，TMU面积仅0.019 mm²，支持超过10种典型张量操作运算符。实验显示，TMU在操作级延迟上比ARM A72和NVIDIA Jetson TX2分别减少了1413倍和8.54倍。与自研TPU结合后，整体系统端到端推理延迟降低了34.6%，展示了其在现代AI SoC中的有效性和可扩展性。

• [WithinReason] 认为该问题本质上是软件问题，通过操作融合可以避免内存访问，从而加快速度。其举例说明在卷积操作前不应显式地做im2col转换，而应通过操作融合来提升性能。虽然对0.019 mm²的面积增加不持反对意见，但隐含的意思是硬件解决方案可能不是最佳途径。

• [mikewarot] 主张通过完全流水线化的方式处理LLM（大型语言模型）的每一层，而不应在内部进行内存访问，以此达到每个时钟周期处理一个token，从而极大地提升处理效率。该观点强调通过硬件设计减少内存访问，并期望将现有效率提高1000倍以上。同时提到每秒处理1亿个token对应的经济价值，暗示高性能硬件的商业潜力。

• [KnuthIsGod] 引用了中国在AI硬件创新上的进展，特别是在面对制裁的情况下推出了TMU（张量操作单元）来高效执行数据移动密集型操作。该评论详细描述了TMU的架构设计、技术参数及其性能优势，强调其在现代AI系统级芯片（SoC）中的集成效果，展示了硬件创新在解决AI计算瓶颈上的实际成果。

• 争议焦点之一是软件优化与硬件加速之间的选择。WithinReason更倾向于软件层面的操作融合，而mikewarot和KnuthIsGod则强调通过硬件设计来提升性能。
• mikewarot特别关注大规模FPGA和流水线设计，期望通过这种方式达到极高的处理速度和经济效益。

Tensor Manipulation Unit (TMU): Reconfigurable, Near-Memory Tensor Manipulation for High-Throughput AI SoC
Authors:

View a PDF of the paper titled Tensor Manipulation Unit (TMU): Reconfigurable, Near-Memory Tensor Manipulation for High-Throughput AI SoC, by Weiyu Zhou and 6 other authors
View PDF
HTML (experimental)
Abstract:
While recent advances in AI SoC design have focused heavily on accelerating tensor computation, the equally critical task of tensor manipulation, centered on high,volume data movement with minimal computation, remains underexplored. This work addresses that gap by introducing the Tensor Manipulation Unit (TMU), a reconfigurable, near-memory hardware block designed to efficiently execute data-movement-intensive operators. TMU manipulates long datastreams in a memory-to-memory fashion using a RISC-inspired execution model and a unified addressing abstraction, enabling broad support for both coarse- and fine-grained tensor transformations. Integrated alongside a TPU within a high-throughput AI SoC, the TMU leverages double buffering and output forwarding to improve pipeline utilization. Fabricated in SMIC 40nm technology, the TMU occupies only 0.019 mm2 while supporting over 10 representative tensor manipulation operators. Benchmarking shows that TMU alone achieves up to 1413 and 8.54 operator-level latency reduction compared to ARM A72 and NVIDIA Jetson TX2, respectively. When integrated with the in-house TPU, the complete system achieves a 34.6% reduction in end-to-end inference latency, demonstrating the effectiveness and scalability of reconfigurable tensor manipulation in modern AI SoCs.

data.title: Using Wave Function Collapse to solve puzzle map generation at scale
data.author: greentec
data.article_summary:
《Logic Islands》是由sublevelgames于2025年6月20日发布的一款益智游戏，玩家需根据预设规则放置岛屿和墙。游戏包含6种不同规则，其中3种使用了WFC（波函数坍缩）算法生成关卡。WFC是一种通过分析源材料的连接模式来生成具有相同连接关系内容的PCG（程序性内容生成）算法，适用于生成2D像素艺术或基于瓦片的游戏地图。

游戏受Nikoli的《Nurikabe》和Lunarch Studios的《Islands of Insight》启发。《Nurikabe》要求网格中的每个单元格为岛屿或墙，岛屿大小由数字指示，墙必须连接且不能出现2x2的墙块。

游戏的6种规则包括：
1. **Classic**：墙必须连接，岛屿不能相邻，不能有2x2的墙。
2. **Modern**：允许2x2的墙，但禁止2x2的岛屿。
3. **Strict**：在Classic基础上增加墙的连接限制。
4. **Minimal**：取消墙的连接要求，所有墙组必须恰好为3个单元。
5. **Orb**：每个岛屿需包含一个紫色 orb，取消墙的连接要求。
6. **Yin-Yang**：没有数字，墙和岛屿都需连接，禁止2x2的墙和岛屿。

Modern、Minimal和Yin-Yang规则在大于7x7的地图生成中遇到问题，后通过WFC算法有效解决墙的连接和2x2墙的限制问题。

主要讨论点：Wave Function Collapse（波函数坍缩，WFC）算法及其应用、与约束求解的关系、以及在逻辑谜题中的实际使用问题。

不同观点：
• [kookamamie] 认为Wave Function Collapse这个名称具有误导性，夸大了算法实际实现的功能。他觉得这个算法名称听起来很宏大，但实际效果相对简单。

• [phi-go] 对WFC算法表示兴趣，并提到其与约束求解（constraint solving）的潜在联系。他指出有一篇论文探讨了这一联系，名为《WaveFunctionCollapse is Constraint Solving in the Wild》，但尚未深入阅读。这表明WFC可能与约束求解有相似的操作方式，值得进一步研究。

• [greentec] 分享了他在开发逻辑谜题游戏《Logic Islands》时遇到的实际问题，以及如何通过WFC算法解决这些问题。他提到在生成大地图时遇到的困难，并通过根据不同规则灵活使用WFC解决了问题。他还强调了WFC在处理复杂约束（如"不允许2x2的块"）时的优势，并展示了其在逻辑谜题中的创新应用。

补充讨论：
• WFC算法的实际应用场景：[greentec] 的案例展示了WFC在逻辑谜题生成中的成功应用，尤其是处理复杂规则和生成问题时的高效性，而不仅限于常见的纹理合成。

• 争议焦点：[kookamamie] 对WFC名称的批评与其他用户对其技术细节和实际应用的积极评价形成对比，显示出对算法名称和实际功能之间差距的关注。

• 理论联系：[phi-go] 提出的WFC与约束求解的关系，以及相关论文的提及，为未来深入研究WFC的理论基础提供了方向。

Background
Logic Islands
, released by sublevelgames on June 20, 2025, is a game where players place islands and walls according to predefined rule sets. The game features 6 different rule sets, and WFC was used to create stages for 3 of these rules. Today, I’d like to share the story behind this implementation.
WFC
WFC (Wave Function Collapse)
is a type of PCG (Procedural Contents Generation) algorithm that analyzes the connectivity patterns of source material to generate output with identical connectivity relationships. Texture Synthesis is the general term for this technique, which creates large result images from small source images.
WFC creates new results based on complex connectivity relationships from the source. Since denser connectivity patterns require more computational resources, it’s better suited for generating sparse outputs. Examples include simple 2D pixel art, 3D tile models, or tile-based game maps shown in the original algorithm.
Nurikabe
Logic Islands is heavily influenced by
Nurikabe
published by Nikoli and the Logic Puzzles from Islands of Insight developed by Lunarch Studios. Nurikabe is a game where each cell in a grid is designated as either island or wall. Numbers in the grid indicate island sizes, each island must contain exactly one number, all walls must be connected, and no 2x2 wall blocks are allowed. Logic Islands uses these conditions as its Classic rule set.
Nurikabe has many derivative rules, each existing as separate games.
Islands of Insight
Islands of Insight
is a fantastic 3D game offering over 10,000 puzzles across 24 types. These puzzles require various skills including reflexes, logic, and observation. Among them, Logic Grid is a game that purely requires logical thinking. Logic Grid breaks down Nurikabe’s basic form further, creating various variations by having players complete patterns without numbers, adding exceptions to certain rules, or introducing additional rules.

Classic
, as mentioned above, uses identical rules to the original Nurikabe.
Modern
allows 2x2 walls but forbids 2x2 islands, creating a fresh map feel.
Strict
adds wall junction restrictions to Classic - walls cannot have 3 or more neighbors - creating more constrained wall patterns.
Minimal
removes the wall connectivity requirement and adds a restriction that all wall groups must be exactly 3 cells.
Orb
requires each island to contain one purple orb and removes the wall connectivity requirement.
Finally,
Yin-Yang
removes numbers from islands but requires all walls to be connected, all islands to be connected, and forbids both 2x2 walls and 2x2 islands, creating map patterns resembling interlocking yin-yang symbols.
Problems with 3 Rules
If everything had ended after creating the map generator, there wouldn’t have been any issues. The game uses maps ranging from 4x4 to 12x12, but some rule sets had problems generating maps larger than 7x7. Modern, Minimal, and Yin-Yang were the problematic rule sets. This was something we couldn’t have known without trying.
The issue with these rule sets was their inability to generate valid wall patterns. The puzzle generation order in my generator worked like this:
For Modern, Minimal, and Yin-Yang, I implemented wall pattern generation using WFC.
Solving Problems with WFC in Detail
When creating wall patterns with WFC, there are two crucial considerations:
How to represent wall connectivity requirements?
How to represent the prohibition of 2x2 walls?
If we can effectively express these two conditions with WFC, we can significantly reduce the time spent searching for random walls.
For map generation, we commonly used Simple-Tiled WFC. Unlike the more complex Overlapping WFC, Simple-Tiled WFC stores each tile and its connection information, then uses this to generate outputs. In the figure below, Simple-Tiled WFC defines 7 types of tiles (a), uses the connection relationships where roads meet non-roads (b), and generates the result (c).

data.title: 2025 Alonzo Church Award: Paul Blain Levy for Call-by-Push-Value (CBPV)
data.author: matt_d
data.article_summary: 2025年Alonzo Church奖授予Paul Blain Levy，以表彰他对效应λ演算的奠基性研究，特别是通过**Call-by-Push-Value（CBPV）**演算实现的功能性与命令式编程的结合。Levy在其2004年的著作和2006年的论文中详细阐述了CBPV，成功整合了20世纪末分化的λ演算研究路径，涵盖代数数据类型、操作语义、指称语义和方程理论等方面。CBPV成为研究计算与逻辑现象的统一框架，涉及效应、极化、项归约、类型同构和程序转换等问题。Levy的工作不仅具有重要科学贡献，还为几十年来逻辑和编程语言语义学研究提供了独特入口。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于使用CBPV（Call-by-Push-Value）的编程语言Forsp的理解和解释

不同观点：
• **HeliumHydride的观点**：提出Forsp是一种使用CBPV（Call-by-Push-Value）范式的编程语言，并提供了一个链接（https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=40633003），该链接可能包含有关Forsp语言的更多信息。这表明HeliumHydride对Forsp和CBPV有一定了解，并认为该链接资源对讨论有帮助。

• **ggm的观点**：对FP（函数式编程）和Lambda演算有一定了解的人请求将Forsp和CBPV的概念用更通俗易懂的语言解释。这表明ggm对当前技术性的讨论感到困惑，希望能有人将其翻译成更易理解的形式，暗示讨论中使用的术语过于专业化或复杂。

补充讨论：
• **技术术语的复杂性**：从ggm的评论中可以看出，CBPV和Forsp涉及的术语和概念可能对非专业人士或不熟悉函数式编程和Lambda演算的读者来说比较难以理解，因此需要简化解释。

• **潜在的学习资源**：HeliumHydride提供的链接可能包含有关Forsp和CBPV的进一步信息，可以作为学习这些概念的资源。然而，是否能通过该链接获取通俗易懂的解释仍需进一步验证。

• **争议焦点**：争议的焦点似乎在于如何更好地理解和解释Forsp和CBPV的概念。对于熟悉函数式编程和Lambda演算的人来说，这些概念可能比较直观，但对于不熟悉这些领域的读者来说，则需要更多的解释和简化。

44335583.article_content:
The 2025
Alonzo Church Award
for Outstanding Contributions to Logic and Computation is presented to
Paul Blain Levy
for his fundamental study of effectful λ-calculi through the Call-by-Push-Value calculus.
The awardee book and paper are:
Paul Blain Levy. Call-By-Push-Value: A Functional/Imperative Synthesis. Semantics Structures in Computation 2, Springer 2004, ISBN 1-4020-1730-8
Paul Blain Levy. Call-by-Push-Value: Decomposing call-by-value and call-by-name. High.-Order Symb. Comput. 19(4): 377-414 (2006)
The Contribution
Initiated by Alonzo Church, the research programme into the λ-calculus as an abstract model of computation has spurred volumes of fundamental research in logic and computation. By the end of the 20th century, the studies of the λ-calculus in its purely logical form and its applied effectful form bifurcated. In an outstanding contribution, Levy has reunited the many existing research streams into the study of one subsuming calculus: Call-by-Push-Value (CBPV). Levy developed and presented an extraordinarily large body of evidence spanning a cross-section of the semantic theory of the λ-calculus and its application to programming language modelling, including: algebraic datatypes, operational semantics, denotational semantics, and equational theories. To date, CBPV remains a unifying starting point in the study of computational and logical phenomena, including: effects, polarisation, term normalisation, type-isomorphisms, and program transformations. In addition to its scientific contribution, the nominated monograph is a unique access-point into the culmination of decades of logic and programming language semantics.

data.title: Show HN: Lego Island Playable in the Browser
data.author: foxtacles
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了LEGO Island网页移植项目，该项目通过Emscripten技术让1997年经典PC游戏在现代浏览器中运行。项目基于原游戏的反编译和可移植版本，由众多贡献者花费大量时间完成，旨在让更多人体验这款经典游戏。项目仍在开发中，可能存在一些bug，支持多种语言和画质设置。此外，文章还提供了相关纪录片、游戏原声直播、wiki资源以及其他开发工具和材料的链接。需要注意的是，该项目是非官方的乐高粉丝项目，与乐高集团无隶属关系。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕《Lego Island》游戏的回忆、技术实现及其合法性问题

不同观点：
• **游戏界面的设计适合性**：tempaway43563认为《Lego Island》的界面设计对于小孩来说过于复杂和抽象，像是由成年人想象出来的设计，而不是经过实际测试的。虽然游戏本身很棒，但现代不会再用这种设计。

• **游戏体验的怀旧与现代重现**：msgodel表达了对《Lego Island》的怀旧之情，提到自己小时候在Windows 95上玩这款游戏的经历。同时，对游戏现在能在浏览器中运行表示惊讶，并提及反编译技术的有效性。lpa22同样表达了怀旧情绪，但认为现代重制的版本缺少当年的感觉。

• **技术实现的讨论**：ycombinatrix对反编译技术表示赞叹，并询问是否基于MattKC的反编译工作。sidewndr46则关注技术细节，特别是Direct3D保留模式如何在浏览器中实现。iqandjoke则提到在检查元素时遇到技术问题，游戏卡住无法继续。

• **对其他类似游戏的期待**：fastball和SwiftyBug分别表达了对《LEGO Racers》和《Lego Island 2》的期待，希望能够重温这些经典游戏。

• **法律与版权问题的关注**：ranger_danger提出了关于游戏资源分发的合法性问题，特别是涉及版权素材和未经许可使用商标/logo的情况。

补充讨论：
• **游戏视频与解说**：Titan2189分享了一个视频链接，似乎与《Lego Island》的背景故事有关。Sarkie则提到MattKC，可能是一位与此游戏或其解说相关的知名人物。

• **其他游戏提及**：johnea提到了"Mata Nui"，这可能是另一款与乐高相关的游戏或角色，但未展开详细讨论。

争议焦点：
• **游戏界面的设计是否适合儿童**：tempaway43563认为游戏的界面设计过于复杂，不适合小孩，而其他人如msgodel和lpa22则更多表达了对游戏整体体验的怀旧和喜爱，未提及界面问题。

• **技术实现的合法性**：ranger_danger对游戏资源的分发和使用是否合法提出质疑，其他人则更多关注技术实现本身，未涉及法律问题。

data.title: CF-Shield – An open source tool to protect any website with Cloudflare
data.author: Sakura-sx
data.article_summary: CF-Shield是一个Python脚本，用于自动检测DDoS攻击并在Cloudflare上启用安全措施。它通过监控CPU使用率，在超过设定阈值时自动应用挑战机制（如托管挑战、JS挑战等）来防御攻击。用户可以通过pip或git安装该脚本，并根据提示配置Cloudflare的电子邮件、API token、区域ID和账户ID等信息。脚本还支持设置Discord、Slack、Telegram等通知方式，以及自定义警报消息和挑战规则的持续时间。依赖库会自动安装，若失败也可手动安装。

• pier25 对Cloudflare是否自动提供DDoS保护提出疑问，显示出他对Cloudflare服务的基本功能可能不太确定，特别是关于DDoS防护是否自动启用。

• Sakura-sx 的评论与其他讨论关系不大，更像是个人的感受表达，并没有直接参与到技术讨论中。

补充讨论：
• phantomathkg 试图明确Cloudflare免费 tier 的具体防护能力，可能是在比较不同的DDoS防护解决方案，关注的是功能差异。

• pier25 的疑问揭示了一些用户对Cloudflare自动防护机制的认知模糊，可能反映出对服务细节缺乏了解。

• 总体而言，争议的焦点可能在于Cloudflare免费 tier 的DDoS防护是否足够详细和自动，以及是否有必要进一步了解或采用其他防护手段。

CF-Shield
CF-Shield is a Python script for detecting DDoS attacks and enabling security measures on Cloudflare automatically.
Installation
Way 1: Using pip
pip install cf-shield
Then to run the script, you can use the following command:
cf-shield
or if it is not in your PATH, you can use the following command:
python3 -m cf-shield
If this fails, you can try using git.
Way 2: Using git
First, you will need to get your Cloudflare email, API token, zone ID, and account ID.
git clone https://github.com/Sakura-sx/cf-shield.git
cd
cf-shield
python3 main.py
When running the script for the first time, it will ask you for your Cloudflare email, API token, zone ID, and account ID. More info on
Setup
.
The dependencies should be installed automatically. If not, you can install them manually by running
python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt
.

data.title: Kubuntu finally removes support for X11 in new installs
data.author: bundie
data.article_summary: Kubuntu决定在即将发布的25.10版本中，对全新安装仅支持Wayland，放弃X11。这一变化反映了Linux开发者普遍认为Wayland是未来趋势，如Linux Mint正在改善Cinnamon对Wayland的支持。Kubuntu开发者希望提前做出改变，以避免在长期支持版26.04中引发更多问题。他们认为维护X11代码阻碍了安全性和新功能的进展，且同时支持两个显示服务器任务繁重。不过，用户仍可通过安装plasma-session-x11来恢复X11会话。并非所有Ubuntu分支都跟进，Xubuntu等预计仍将提供X11选项。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：用户对从X11环境迁移到Wayland的强制性举措的态度

不同观点：
• [反对迁移观点] DaSHacka认为，从X11迁移到Wayland是“强制性”的，并批评Wayland为“半成品解决方案”。该评论者显然对现有X11环境感到满意，且认为向Wayland的迁移是不成熟和被迫的，表现出对现有工作环境被改变的不满。
   
• [支持迁移观点] 此观点未在评论中直接呈现，但可以从反对者的言论中推测出可能存在支持迁移的群体。这类用户可能认为Wayland是未来趋势，具备技术优势（如更好的性能、安全性或对现代图形硬件的支持），并希望社区能够更快地过渡到这一新环境。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于Wayland是否已经成熟到足以替代X11。DaSHacka明确表示Wayland仍是一个“半成品”，暗示其功能或稳定性可能存在问题，而支持者可能认为这些问题是过渡期正常的，长期来看Wayland会更加优越。

• 另一个讨论点是用户选择的自由。反对者认为这种迁移并非用户自愿，而是被技术发展“逼迫”所致，反映出对技术决策过程中用户自主权受限的不满。

• 例子方面，DaSHacka提到“用户不愿意从现有的X11环境切换”，这表明在实际使用中，X11仍然能够满足大多数用户需求，而Wayland的必要性或优势尚未被所有用户认可。

44351347.article_content:
X11, the old window system whose days have long felt numbered, just saw another one of its major supporters head for the exit. Kubuntu has decided to follow its parent distro's lead, making its next release, version 25.10, a Wayland-only affair for fresh installs.
It seems many Linux developers see Wayland as the future. Just recently, Linux Mint
started working to improve support for the protocol in Cinnamon,
tackling lingering issues with keyboard layouts and input methods. You can
even see the progress in KDE's development
, where an upgrade to Wayland PiP is planned for KDE Plasma 6.5.
So what's the logic behind dropping a session that, for the most part, still works?
According to Kubuntu's Rik Mills
, the team wants to "rip off this sticking plaster" now, in an interim release, rather than piss off a lot of people by doing it in the next Long-Term Support version, 26.04. The developers feel that maintaining code for the aging X11 system holds back progress on security and new features that Wayland can enable more easily. Plus, supporting two separate display servers is a massive undertaking.
Of course, this change might have some people worried, but relax; all is not lost if you still need the old session. If you're running hardware that acts up, like some older NVIDIA cards, or who relies on an ancient application that doesn't play nicely with the XWayland compatibility layer, you can still get your familiar session back. Just enter the following command in your terminal:
sudo apt install plasma-session-x11
Once that command finishes, the X11 session will appear as an option on the login screen, so you can carry on as before.
As OMGUbuntu notes
, not everyone in the Ubuntu family is following its lead just yet. Other official flavors like Xubuntu, Ubuntu Budgie, and Ubuntu Cinnamon are expected to keep offering an X11 session on their default installs for this cycle.

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：如何看待问题的解决与付费意愿

不同观点：
• GianFabien认为当今世界面临许多重大问题，如气候变化、能源不稳定、贫困、营养不良等，但有效的解决方案仍在等待实施。该评论强调了全球性问题的紧迫性和当前解决方案的不足。

• YAndreaRusso将讨论转向个人健康问题，提到曾帮助某人制定治疗膝盖疼痛的计划，表明问题不仅限于商业或全球性问题，也可以是个人健康问题。

• al_borland对为解决问题付费的意愿持谨慎态度，指出许多人做出的大胆声明往往无法兑现，付费的多少取决于问题是否真正得到解决。该评论强调了对解决方案实际效果的怀疑。

• kylebenzle用夸张的语气表示，如果有人能帮助其公司每年赚取1亿美元的利润，公司愿意支付高额薪水（高达100万美元/年），反映了在商业环境中对问题解决者的高价值认可。

• orionblastar提到自己患有无法治愈的精神疾病（分裂情感性障碍），这使得他难以工作和记住事情，表达了对某些问题无法解决的无奈和接受。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是解决方案的有效性和实际影响。al_borland对许多声称有效的解决方案持怀疑态度，而GianFabien则强调全球性问题的紧迫性和当前解决方案的不足。

• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是个体对问题解决的不同需求和期望。YAndreaRusso关注个人健康问题，而kylebenzle则强调商业环境中的高价值问题解决能力。

• orionblastar的评论引入了一些问题可能无法解决的观点，增加了讨论的深度，提示并非所有问题都有现成的或可实现的解决方案。

data.title: Bluetooth Jammer
data.author: yeknoda
data.article_summary: ESP32-BlueJammer是一个基于ESP32和nRF24模块的干扰设备，能够干扰2.4GHz频段的通信，包括蓝牙、BLE、WiFi、遥控无人机等。它通过产生噪声和发送不必要的包来中断设备间的通信，适用于安全测试和受控干扰。设备有效范围超过30米，可使用更大天线或放大器增强信号。注意，干扰通信在许多地方是违法的，该项目仅用于教育目的。使用时需准备ESP32开发模块、两个nRF24L01+PA+LNA模块等硬件，并通过按键切换不同干扰模式，OLED显示当前通道，状态LED指示当前干扰类型。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于一个潜在的干扰设备的用途、合法性及其应用场景的讨论

不同观点：
• btreecat：认为该设备可能通过精确定位干扰实现有效作用，特别是在测试遥控控制链路的弹性时。他还分享了在油井平台使用LoRa技术提高连接稳定性的实际经验，并表示希望在实验室测试该设备以增强实际应用的信心。
• InTheBarn：质疑该项目的合法性，认为使用此类设备可能会导致用户面临法律问题，如罚款。
• mfkp：提出该设备可能在抵制通过蓝牙信标跟踪用户位置和购物习惯的场景中有用，但也提到简单的解决方案如不带手机和用现金支付。
• phplovesong：指出项目源代码缺失的问题。
• pixelpoet：对项目的README文件中大量使用感叹号表示调侃。
• wtcactus：认为虽然该设备可能非法，但在其国家对类似行为的执法不严，因此考虑自制并使用于公共场所如海滩。
• amatecha：希望此类干扰设备合法，因为他在户外徒步时受到他人使用大音量蓝牙音箱的干扰，认为自己应有权通过RF干扰抵制这种声音污染。
• BonoboIO：认为该设备是解决公共场所大音量蓝牙音箱问题的暴力解决方案。
• Havoc：询问该设备是否会干扰WiFi。

ESP32-BlueJammer
The ESP32-BlueJammer (Bluetooth jammer, BLE jammer, WiFi jammer, RC jammer) disrupts various devices using an ESP32 and nRF24 modules, causing plenty of noise and sending unnecessary packets (DoS).
It interrupts:
The whole 2.4GHz broadband!
Everything that works on 2.4GHz is being interfered, like:
audio in speakers being transmitted over bluetooth, microphones on 2.4GHz, smartphone connections, WiFi, RC Drones (etc.), IoT devices, smart gadgets, wireless keyboard & mouse, just anything on 2.4GHz!
Ideal for controlled disruption and security testing. Based on 2,4GHz communication.
It has a big range (over 30Meters+ - may vary on your antenna and hardware setup!) on newest Bluetooth versions with casual 2.4GHz antennas, you can easily increase this aswell by taking some simple "bigger" router antennas.
An amplifier (2.4GHz) may be an good option too!
Remember that jamming is illegal and should not be used with malicious intent!

44350448.article_summary: ESP32-BlueJammer是一个基于ESP32和nRF24模块的干扰设备，能够干扰2.4GHz频段的通信，包括蓝牙、BLE、WiFi、遥控无人机等。它通过产生噪声和发送不必要的包来中断设备间的通信，适用于安全测试和受控干扰。设备有效范围超过30米，可使用更大天线或放大器增强信号。注意，干扰通信在许多地方是违法的，该项目仅用于教育目的。使用时需准备ESP32开发模块、两个nRF24L01+PA+LNA模块等硬件，并通过按键切换不同干扰模式，OLED显示当前通道，状态LED指示当前干扰类型。

data.author: audionerd
data.article_summary: LaborBerlin正在开发一种采用开源技术和常见零件的模块化16mm电影放映机，以解决老旧设备不可靠和难以维修的问题。该项目始于2023年3月，计划在2025年9月完成原型，并在鹿特丹的Back To The Future Festival上展示。项目分为多个阶段，包括高密度LED测试、800W LED原型开发和解决闪烁问题。目标是打造一个适应现代艺术家和档案放映需求的新型放映机，具备可调节高度、亮度可调的超亮LED光源、多种帧率和格式支持，以及与多种音频和数字系统的同步功能。该设计还将兼容老式镜头，并具备便携性和灵活性，以适应不同放映环境。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于老式电影放映机（16mm/35mm）项目的可行性、技术细节和实际应用的讨论

不同观点：
• **ilamont**：认为该项目在某些方面（如可调LED和开源/3D打印部件）值得赞赏，但整体过于复杂。提到16mm/35mm电影已经逐渐淡出，且很多技术功能（如手动变速播放）过于小众，建议简化功能，专注于满足大部分现有胶片的基本需求。他还提到可以参考过去的简易塑料胶片放映机（如Super 8）。
• **moonshinefe**：表达了对老式放映机的怀旧情感，认为保持这种媒介的活力很有意义，但未对技术细节发表意见。
• **luckystarr**：对胶片比老式放映机具有更好的色彩保留感到惊讶，之前一直以为旧电影色彩褪色是由于录制不良。
• **sho_hn**：对项目非常感兴趣，表示自己有相关技术背景，愿意参与，尤其因为对 arthouse/program 电影院的感情。
• **M4rkJW**：认为该项目可以作为开源胶片扫描仪的第一步，表示自己有8mm和16mm胶片需要存档。
• **sandworm101**：对项目中使用AOI CPU冷却器的实用性提出质疑，指出其密封性、蒸发问题以及散热效率的不足，建议加强风扇或增加散热器面积。
• **the_third_wave**：质疑为何需要800W的LED才能达到250W卤素灯泡的亮度，通常LED效率更高，这种反差让他感到不解。
• **gwbas1c**：对项目支持多种帧率的必要性表示好奇。
• **yapyap**：对档案馆使用16mm放映机的目的和方式提出疑问，认为直接将胶片扫描存档比投影后拍摄更合理。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是该项目功能的复杂性与实际需求之间的矛盾，尤其是针对小众功能（如手动变速播放）的必要性。
• 另一技术争议点是关于使用800W LED的效率问题，以及对AOI CPU冷却器的实用性讨论。
• 关于胶片存档的具体方法（投影 vs 扫描）也引发了部分讨论，涉及到不同方式的实际效果和合理性。

LaborBerlin: State-of-the-Art 16mm Projector
Background
While artists all over the world continue to work with celluloid film, they are often confronted with precarious screening conditions due to increasingly old and hard to repair equipment. In particular, film projectors and their aging mechanical parts have become less dependable, contributing in many cases to the destruction of the film material instead of ensuring its optimal presentation. The last 16mm commercially available film projector was built in the 90’s but most artists, archivists and projectionists have to deal with much older equipment, sometimes going back to the 60’s and 50’s. At the same time, the traditional industrial manufacturers have disappeared or shifted to other fields, service personnel have retired and spare parts are rare and unreasonably priced. Designed mainly for standard film projections, vintage projectors also fail to cater to contemporary demands: While not offering enough flexibility for artists who work in expanded cinema, they also don’t usually meet the needs of archival projection. Along with the digital revolution, which has, in the last decade, already greatly reduced the opportunities for experiencing analogue film projection, the aging technology of vintage projection equipment has become an important factor in the disappearance of analogue film projection and the uniqueness of its experience.
Introduction
Our idea is to develop a state-of-the-art and modular 16mm film projector using only open-source technologies and non-proprietary/commonly available spare parts. We believe that especially the central mechanical elements of the old projectors – claw mechanism, shutter wheel and film transport - are in most cases so well engineered that a new development here would be a waste of time and energy. Instead, we want to build the projector on the basis of an existing - and easily available - projector mechanism. The same applies to the optics: lenses that are compatible with projectors made by Eiki, Bauer, Bell & Howell and Hokushin are available worldwide in good condition. This projector should cater to the needs of contemporary film artists, archivists and projectionists alike.
Technical Features (Wish List)
Design
Modular design
Open source technologies
Non-proprietary & commonly available spare parts (3D-printable)
Adjustable height & tilt
Lightweight for travelling & portability during projection
Option to project in vertical format (90° tilted or Prism system)
Power
110V & 220V
Optional: Battery for outdoor & portability during projection
Light source
Super bright, dimmable LED
Color temperature adjustment for differently timed prints,Tungsten or Xenon or redshifted film prints
Digital shutter (flicker)
Film formats
16mm – Super-16 – Ultra-16 – open gate
(with switchable format masks)
Steady focus between print & reversal stocks
Optional: interchangeable sprocket wheels for shrunk film
Optics
Wide zoom range lens 25mm – 150mm
Compatible with Bauer, Eiki & B&H lenses (adapter tubes)
Focus with Worm Gear
Anamorphic lens holder
Holder for Elmo Viewer Type 100 (viewing without screen)
Transport
Crystal sync speeds: 12 – 15 – 16,66 – 18 – 23,976 – 24 – 25 – 29,97 – 30 FPS
Manual vario-speed from < 1 to 30 FPS
Vario shutter wheel independent from FPS
Digital frame counter
Memory counter for in- and out-point
Fast rewind in both directions
Audio
Optical & magnetic audio (no built-in amplifier – just outputs)
Microphone input for live voice
Headphone jack
Integrated digital audio sync system
Connectivity
Sync with digital audio, video & midi
Sync between several projectors
Switchable from master to slave
Sync with Elmo ESS system
Optional: ready for telecine
Remote control: IR / Cable / Bluetooth
Accessories
Development of a compatible looper device
Spool arm extensions
PHASE I
State of the Project – March 2023
Our project takes place over a period of two and a half years, and should be completed by September 2025 with the presentation of a prototype at the Back To The Future Festival in Rotterdam.
As a first step, in a team of two, we disassembled four film projector models, which we found offered a suitable mechanical system that could serve as the basis for further development. We have defined three fields of development, for which we will have to collaborate with different experts. These fields are light source, film transport mechanism and electronics.

data.author: mattcollins
data.article_summary: 本文主要报道了美国和伊朗之间的紧张局势升级。美国轰炸了伊朗的三个核设施，伊朗总统表示美国必须为侵略行为负责。美国总统特朗普称此次打击阻止了伊朗拥核，而伊朗外长则表示核知识无法通过轰炸摧毁。联合国无法评估Fordo地下设施的损害。早些时候，美国国防部长表示打击并非为了政权更替，而是阻止伊朗获得核武器。BBC分析了卫星图片，显示了伊斯法罕和纳坦兹的损害。与此同时，伊朗和以色列继续互相攻击，以色列声称打击了数十个军事目标，而伊朗红新月会指责以色列袭击了医院和医疗中心。文章最后提出了一个关键问题：伊朗是否仍拥有足够的高浓铀和制造核武器的能力，从而加速制造 crude 核弹？这可能导致中东的核军备竞赛。

Live Reporting

We're moving our live coverage of the conflict in the Middle East to a new page -

Frank Gardner
Security correspondent
The big question in all of this
is an even more worrying one than "
will Iran try to close the strategic Straitof Hormuz?
" - although that would certainly have major economic, political and
military consequences.
Instead, the gravest question of all, to which almost
none of us know the answer is this:
Does Iran still retain enough
Highly Enriched Uranium (HEU), hidden away at a secret underground location,
plus the knowledge and the means to weaponise it, to now take a decision to
race for a crude nuclear bomb?
In other words, have the
combined US and Israeli attacks removed the threat of Iran becoming a
nuclear-armed state â or made it more likely?
A military expert I have spoken
to maintains that if Iran has managed to preserve enough of its HEU then its
scientists should, if left to work unimpeded, be able to test a simple,
first-generation gun-type device using a neutron initiator. This device, he
says, is easier to engineer than an implosion device.
It has long been assumed that if
Iran acquires the bomb then Saudi Arabia and other states in the Middle East
will also try to acquire it, triggering a nuclear arms race.

Following the comments from the
Iranian representative at the UN Security Council
, we heard from Israel who says the world should be thanking Donald Trump.
"The entire world should say on record here today thank you,"  Danny Danon says. "Thank you to Donald Trump for acting when so many hesitated."
He says that some at the UN have "denounced" the US and Israel, but queries "where were you when Iran enriched uranium far beyond the point of civilian usage, when it built a fortress beneath a mountain to prepare for our extermination?"
He says that it cannot be ignored that "diplomacy was tried" but says Iran "turned negotiation into theatre" and used it as "camouflage" to buy time to build missiles and enrich uranium.
Danon continues, saying that Iran negotiated agreements "it never intended to keep".
"The free world gave it every chance," he says. Danon says the cost of inaction would have been "a death sentence".
